summary: PCIe one-shot and DMA all-reduce at world size 3; PDL flags take effect
details: Three-GPU deployments (GLM-5.3-Flash TP3) use the B12X one-shot and DMA all-reduce instead of the NCCL fallback.
B12X_PCIE_ONESHOT_PDL and B12X_MHC_PDL, already set by the GLM profile, now let the mHC kernel overlap the all-reduce it consumes.
